## Breaking change
The "PIN" value currently is an integer but will need to be prefixed with D for RPI platforms.

## Proposed change
The current DHT component uses the deprecated Adafruit library. This PR converts to the ciruitpython version. The Adafruit library does not seem to work correctly with Python 3.8 which will become an issue when support for 3.7 is dropped in December.

I think this is a bit confusing, Debian's `libgpiod2` is the same library as Alpines `libgpiod`.

Home Assistant containers are currently based on Alpine 3.12 which has [libgpiod 1.4.2-r1](https://pkgs.alpinelinux.org/package/v3.12/community/x86_64/libgpiod) in its feed. Raspbian is currently based on buster which has [libgpiod 1.2](https://packages.debian.org/source/buster/libgpiod) in its feed. The rpi-sensors repo has a [Dockerfile](https://github.com/Tob1as/rpi-sensors/blob/507025f482d4642fdf57cff3872dfd97b83b07aa/alpine.armhf.python.Dockerfile) which uses Alpine and installs the package `libgpiod`, so I think it should just work by installing Alpines `libgpiod` in the container.

To install a new package in the container you have to add it to the Dockerfile in the base container at https://github.com/home-assistant/docker/. If only containers for certain machines should get the package add it to the machine specific Dockerfile at https://github.com/home-assistant/core/tree/dev/machine.
